analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($82.88) vs SMA5/20/50 ($83.07/$82.50/$83.62): short-term resistance, approaching mid-term support
· Below SMA100/200 ($84.13/$85.02): mid-to-long term trend weakness
· 52-week position (15.5%): recovery phase from historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.2→50.2): attempting to exit oversold, confirming upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0691→0.1823): continued improvement, no bearish reversal signal confirmed
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $82.50): consolidation near mid-band, lack of direction
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($82.77): based on EMA10, acting as short-term support
· Swing resistance ($84.34): downtrend resistance from 52-week highs
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: consolidation phase, no clear Higher Low or Lower High formed
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.41x): increased volume on upward moves, slightly higher confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, with short-term rebound attempts amidst persistent mid-to-long term downtrend. Conditions for maintaining wait-and-see: confirmation of RSI holding above 50 and breaking above SMA5.
